name: Ingis
_grid: One character per tile, row 0 = the far side (player 2), last row = player 1's side. Each character is defined in the legend. From the old map image (maps/ingis.jpg): a basalt ridge (one level up) running corner to corner with the three capture zones on it, lava pools on the volcanic sand around it. Rock coordinates: x = column 1-16 from player 1's left, y = row 1-16 from player 1's side.
_legend: level = height step (0 = lowest); tiles interact only within 1 level. surface picks the look from the palette. sink = the surface sits this many world units lower than its level (a look only: lava counts as the ground's level). marker = something on the tile (painted, or a 3D piece with piece: true). zone: capture zone tiles; each 2x2 group gets a frame piece that takes the colour of the player with more Pokemon in it.
_coords: Paint the rock coordinates 1-16 along the board's edges (player 1's x and y; upside down on player 2's sides).
_board: The published board files the map picker uses (from tools/build_board.py; update when a new version is published), then run tools/build_arena_index.py.
_table: Image for the table around the board (placeholder until the arena gets its own).
_textures: Placeholders from tools/draw_placeholders.py: volcanic sand on the ground, hexagonal basalt column tops on the ridge, basalt columns on every cliff, glowing lava.
